newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian late rubber higher on Thai trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian late rubber higher on Thai trading.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber offer prices were higher in late trading on Wednesday, supported by higher Thai rubber prices, traders said.
They said news that Thai prices were boosted on short-covering and supply of RSS3 grade rubber over the past few days had improved the local market sentiment.
"Basically prices go up because there is demand in the market. A deal was done at 47.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan this afternoon for July/August shipment," said one trader.
"Market sentiment has also improved because of the Thai factor," said another trader.
Traders said SIR20 offer prices were higher at 47.00 fob Padang and Surabaya, at 46.75 fob Padang, at 46.875 fob Pontianak and at 46.50 fob Jambi.
